    <h1 id="hero-title">Hello, I'm <span class="hero-name">Eunji</span></h1>
    <p class="hero-description">I am from <strong>South Korea</strong> and am currently a <strong>Ph.D. Candidate</strong> at <strong>Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST)</strong>, where I conduct my doctoral research under the supervision of <strong><a class="advisor-link" href="https://dhcha.unist.ac.kr/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="Prof. Dong-Hyun Cha lab website (opens in a new tab)">Prof. Dong-Hyun Cha</a></strong>.</p>
    <p class="hero-description">My research focuses on <strong>tropical cyclones and their associated rainfall</strong> over the western North Pacific, with particular interests in subseasonal-to-seasonal prediction, global climate model evaluation, and regional atmospheric modeling. I explore how large-scale environmental conditions influence tropical cyclone activity and how numerical simulations can better represent tropical cyclone rainfall.</p>
